candidate.source: 02-define.json — 17 elements classified by Define stage (11 constants, 4 variables, 1 unidentified, 1 domain artifact)

mappings.reason: PROCESS.md exists at declared CTB position with all three cluster headers (Identity §1-4, Contract §3-6, Governance §7-12). Single parseable document. No transformation required.

18/18 fields present (10 process table + 8 HEIR YAML). All named, all non-empty. Direct 1:1 mapping to L5 spec. Note: heir.yaml has process_id as 'PROC-DOL' while PROCESS.md §1 has 'PROC-400' — inconsistency but both present.

All 5 sub-components present: Two-Question Intake (2 questions answered), Input (prose), Middle (4-row, 5-col table), Output (names LCS Pipeline consumer), Circle (annual cycle described). Maps 1:1 to L8 spec.
All 4 sub-sections present: READ table (6 rows, 3 cols), WRITE table (1 row declaring none), Join Chain (tree notation to spine), Forbidden Paths (4 entries). Maps 1:1 to L9 spec.

TARGET ABSENT. No Define table (L19), no Map table (L20), no Join table (L21) exist in PROCESS.md. §6 has C&V declaration (L11) but the three DMJ step tables required by L10/L19/L20/L21 are entirely missing. This is the largest structural gap — 3 sub-layers with 0 content.
7 stop conditions in §7 (2-col table: Condition, Action). All 6 canonical conditions covered plus 1 domain-specific. Exceeds minimum. Maps 1:1 to L12 spec.
9 numbered smoke test steps with action → expected result in §9. Three Primitives Check present (Thing/Flow/Change, all 3 questions). Maps 1:1 to L13 spec.

All 3 sub-sections present but ALL deviate from required schemas. (1) Metrics table §10 has 5 cols (Metric, Type, Baseline, First Run, Notes) — missing Target and Tolerance columns vs L22 spec (Metric, Unit, Baseline, Target, Tolerance). (2) Sigma tracking §10 has wrong column structure vs L23 spec (Metric, Run1, Run2, Run3+, Trend, Action). (3) ORBT gate rules §10 are 4 bullet-point rules, not L24 3-col table (From, To, Gate). Requires restructuring all 3 sub-schemas.

Logbook §11 has narrative entries with ~9 ad-hoc fields (date, ORBT, trigger, records, errors, tools, result, learnings, ORBT after). Target requires 14-field structured schema (trace_id, run_id, step, target, actual, delta, status, error_code, error_message, tools_used, duration_ms, cost_cents, timestamp, signed_by). 14/14 required fields absent from current schema. Content exists but format is wrong — full schema replacement required.

§10 has 4 sigma interpretation bullets (tightening/flat/expanding/strike 3). Target requires 3-col table (From, To, Gate) with 4 explicit state transitions: BUILD→OPERATE, OPERATE→REPAIR, REPAIR→OPERATE, Any→TROUBLESHOOT/TRAIN. Current content describes sigma rules, not state machine transitions. Auditor ≠ builder constraint not stated. Requires complete replacement.
§6 has two bullet lists: 10 constants and 6 variables. Correctly separates structure from fill. Maps 1:1 to L11 spec.
§2 has 2-sentence prose naming what breaks without this process and downstream dependency (LCS Pipeline). Maps 1:1 to L6 spec.
§4 has blueprint reference, snap-on tools, databases, tools & integrations, secrets. §8 has upstream dependencies and downstream consumers. All 4 L7 sub-tables present. Maps 1:1 to L7 spec.

TARGET ABSENT. No formal certification record exists with the required 7-field schema (heir_ref, orbt_entered, orbt_exited, action, gates_passed, signed_by, signed_at). Process is in OPERATE state but no BUILD→OPERATE auditor sign-off is documented. §11 logbook entry mentions 'BUILD → OPERATE' transition but not in certification schema format.

§12 Known Issues has 6 columns (#, Date, Issue, Root Cause, Fix, Strikes). Target L17 requires 7-column Failure Pattern Registry (Pattern ID, Location, Error Code, First Seen, Occurrences, Strike Count, Status) plus separate Strike Rules sub-section. Missing: Pattern ID, Location, Error Code, Occurrences, Status columns. Has: #, Date, Issue, Root Cause, Fix (not in spec). Column overlap partial — requires restructure.

§13 has 3-column table (Date, What Was Done, imo-brain Document). L18 spec is (Date, What Was Done, Knowledge Record ID). Third column is a rename — 'imo-brain Document' → 'Knowledge Record ID'. Functionally equivalent. Minor rename, structurally direct.

The 6 SQL view definitions in src/001_dol_views.sql are the domain implementation — the executable code this process governs. No direct template layer target exists because the unified template describes process documentation structure, not runtime code. SQL source is referenced by L8 Middle table (Step 2, Tool Used: 'psql -f') and L13 Verification (smoke test queries). Mapped as domain artifact supporting multiple layers.

unmapped_gaps.description: The three DMJ step tables (Define, Map, Join) are entirely absent from PROCESS.md. This is the single largest gap — 3 sub-layers with zero content. L10 is an invariant set comparator layer. Without these tables, the process has no formal structure extraction — raw DOL data enters but its element-level definition, mapping to target columns, and join path to spine are undocumented in DMJ format.
unmapped_gaps.remediation: Add three tables to PROCESS.md: (1) L19 Define — 5-col table (Element, ID, Format, Description, C-or-V) listing all DOL data elements. (2) L20 Map — 3-col table (Source, Target, Transform) connecting DOL elements to slot_workbench or LCS target columns. (3) L21 Join — 3-col table (Join Path, Type, Description) documenting EIN → ack_id → outreach_id chain. §5 OSAM join chain content can inform L21 but is not a substitute — different schema.

unmapped_gaps.description: No formal certification record with 7-field schema exists. Process claims OPERATE state but has no auditor-signed BUILD→OPERATE transition record. §11 logbook has a narrative entry for the transition but not in the required schema.
unmapped_gaps.remediation: Add L16 certification record section with schema: heir_ref, orbt_entered, orbt_exited, action, gates_passed (imo/ctb/circle), signed_by, signed_at. First entry should document the BUILD→OPERATE transition. Cannot be self-certified — requires auditor ≠ builder.

unmapped_gaps.description: All 3 measurement sub-sections exist but deviate from required column schemas. L22 metrics missing Target/Tolerance columns. L23 sigma tracking has wrong column structure entirely. L24 ORBT gates expressed as bullets not as 3-col state transition table.
unmapped_gaps.remediation: Restructure §10 into 3 compliant sub-sections: (1) Metrics table → 5-col (Metric, Unit, Baseline, Target, Tolerance). (2) Sigma tracking → 6-col (Metric, Run1, Run2, Run3+, Trend, Action). (3) ORBT gate rules → 3-col (From, To, Gate) with 4 transitions.

unmapped_gaps.description: Logbook §11 uses narrative entries (~9 ad-hoc fields). Target requires structured 14-field trace schema. 14/14 required fields absent from current format.
unmapped_gaps.remediation: Replace or supplement §11 narrative with structured trace schema: trace_id, run_id, step, target, actual, delta, status, error_code, error_message, tools_used, duration_ms, cost_cents, timestamp, signed_by. Existing narrative entries can be migrated into the new schema.

unmapped_gaps.description: §12 Known Issues has 6-col table that partially overlaps L17 Failure Pattern Registry (7-col). Missing: Pattern ID, Location, Error Code, Occurrences, Status. Also missing: separate Strike Rules sub-section.
unmapped_gaps.remediation: Restructure §12 into L17 compliant format: 7-col Failure Pattern Registry (Pattern ID, Location, Error Code, First Seen, Occurrences, Strike Count, Status) + Strike Rules sub-section (1→repair, 2→scrutiny, 3→Troubleshoot/Train→AD).

unmapped_gaps.description: heir.yaml has process_id: 'PROC-DOL' while PROCESS.md §1 has Process ID: 'PROC-400'. Both refer to the same process. Inconsistency does not prevent mapping but will cause agent routing confusion.
unmapped_gaps.remediation: Align heir.yaml process_id to 'PROC-400' to match PROCESS.md. Or update PROCESS.md to 'PROC-DOL'. One canonical ID.

unresolved_mapping_count.measurement: Count of defined elements mapped to a target layer where the target content is entirely absent in the subject (type = unresolved). These are structural holes — the element was identified by Define but has nothing to connect to.

schema_deviation_count.measurement: Count of defined elements where source content exists but schema deviates from target spec, requiring transformation (type = transformed). Content present, format wrong.

target_gap_count.measurement: Count of distinct target layers from the invariant set (10 layers) that have structural gaps requiring remediation — either absent content or schema mismatch. Union of unresolved + transformed mappings scoped to invariant set layers only.

unmapped_field_count.measurement: Total count of individual required fields/columns across all gap layers that are absent or wrong. L19: 5 cols × 0 rows = 5 missing. L20: 3 cols × 0 rows = 3 missing. L21: 3 cols × 0 rows = 3 missing. L22: 2 cols missing (Target, Tolerance). L23: 6 cols wrong = 6 missing. L24: 3 cols × 4 rows = 3 missing. L15: 14 fields missing. L16: 7 fields missing. L17: 5 cols missing + strike rules sub-section = 6 missing.

direct_mapping_deficit.measurement: Count of 17 defined elements that did NOT achieve direct mapping (type != direct). Includes transformed (4), unresolved (2), inferred (1). Lower = more elements map cleanly without transformation.
